title: Reproducibility of the homogeneity effect: does it hold on a fresh, non-Infinity-Chat prompt set?

original_idea.body:
# Reproducibility of the homogeneity effect

Collect a fresh ~200-prompt open-ended set from a different source; run the published diversity metrics on 8-10 models and compare effect sizes to Infinity-Chat numbers. Inference + embeddings on a consumer GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (replication validates a safety-relevant effect) but impact on catastrophic risk is foundational/indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 5: collect prompts, reuse published metrics on open models; standard tooling, beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 5: tightly scoped replication with a clear effect-size comparison criterion.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: independent replication is classic outside-lab work; public models/metrics, no internal access.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of a published effect; little new conceptual ground.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Direct out-of-distribution replication of an existing result.
